einzeiler: Lululemon shares drop after cutting full-year guidance amid slowing sales in China.
kurzfassung: Lululemon cut its full-year sales guidance and reported a larger-than-expected decline in revenue. Meanwhile, Tesla launched limited cyber-cab rides in Austin, and Volkswagen approved a restructuring plan involving significant job cuts. Investors are also closely watching the upcoming August jobs report and market data.
stichpunkte: Lululemon cut its full-year sales guidance, projecting a contraction of 5-7%.
The retailer reported a 4% decrease in second-quarter revenue and a 9% drop in comparable sales.
Tesla began offering cyber-cab rides in Austin, Texas, with limited public access and no media present at the launch.
Volkswagen's supervisory board approved a restructuring program adding 50,000 more job cuts, bringing the total expected reduction to 100,000.
Stock index futures remained largely flat as markets awaited the August employment situation report.
Analysts note that sixty days before the U.S. midterm elections marks the window when investment managers begin adjusting portfolios.

clips.hook: Features of the golden two-seater vehicle
clips.text: The autonomous vehicle operates without a steering wheel or pedals, relying entirely on cameras and sensors for navigation, and restricts young children from riding.
The automaker's leadership officially endorsed a comprehensive plan aimed at transforming the business and improving its competitive standing.

clips.hook: Expectations for the August jobs report
clips.text: Economists anticipate the upcoming employment figures will show modest non-farm payroll growth alongside a steady unemployment rate and wage increases.
PricewaterhouseCoopers released a multi-trillion-dollar estimate regarding worldwide expenditures on data centers leading up to the year 2050.
Trading will pause on Monday because of the holiday, with regular podcast episodes resuming on Tuesday.

beschreibung:
Another forecast trim, a China slowdown, and rising competition send lululemon (LULU) shares tumbling. (00:15) The robotaxi era begins with little fanfare as Tesla (TSLA) rolls out Cybercab rides in Austin. (01:49) Volkswagen (VWAGY) is preparing another 50,000 job cuts. (03:03)
